test_rolling_skew_series: test rolling skew on a pandas Series with a fixed window size and compare against scipy.stats.skew
test_rolling_kurt_frame: test rolling kurtosis on a pandas DataFrame with a fixed window size and compare against scipy.stats.kurtosis
test_rolling_skew_time_rule: test rolling skew on a time-resampled pandas Series with business-day window and min_periods
test_rolling_skew_nans: test rolling skew and kurtosis with NaN values and verify min_periods behavior
test_rolling_skew_center: test rolling skew and kurtosis with center=True and verify alignment via index reindexing
test_rolling_skew_scale_invariant: test that rolling skew and kurtosis are scale-invariant under extreme multiplicative factors
test_rolling_skew_edge_cases: test rolling skew edge cases including zero-variance windows and small windows yielding all NaN
test_rolling_kurt_edge_cases: test rolling kurtosis edge cases including zero-variance windows and small windows yielding all NaN
test_rolling_skew_eq_value: test that rolling skew returns NaN for all-equal values in the window
test_rolling_kurt_eq_value: test that rolling kurtosis returns NaN for all-equal values in the window
